name: decline_not_a_name
description: Caller declines a visit politely. The name extractor must reject 'Not really' (and similar) so the FSM doesn't mistake the decline for a name capture.

turns.text: Yeah, just wanted to know about your projects.
Sure! We have Skyline Heights in Tukkuguda with premium 3 and 4 BHK apartments. Would you like to schedule a site visit?
Not really, but thank you for the information.
